title: Scarborough Fair
description: Adds an End-shaped grass-and-stone floating-island dimension with synced day-night sky, larger sun and moon, trees, water pools, and outer-island entry.
body:
# Scarborough Fair

**Scarborough Fair** adds a new End-shaped floating-island dimension: grass-covered surfaces, overworld-style stone and ore strata inside, synced day-night sky, larger sun and moon, oak and birch trees, small water pools, occasional water-covered islands drifting over the void, and optional Aether-style starting-spawn behavior.

![Scarborough Fair long view](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/z5hMk6rz/images/2ba3f4f9566707a5f13e6b13efef19a8edec17eb_350.webp)

## Features

- New dimension: `scarborough_fair:scarborough_fair`.
- Terrain follows the vanilla End island silhouette, keeping the floating outer-island feel.
- Island top surfaces are grass blocks, while sides and undersides use dirt and interiors use overworld base stone.
- The dimension follows the normal day-night cycle and renders the sun and moon at twice their usual size.
- The island biomes are tagged as overworld / plains / forest so ore, stone-replacement, and other data-driven worldgen can hook in naturally.
- Chorus plants are replaced by oak and birch trees.
- Small water pools can appear on islands.
- Rare water islands can cover most of an island; edge gaps may let water flow down into the void.
- Common config can optionally start new players in Scarborough Fair, Aether-style: first join changes dimension to an outer island and sets that initial personal respawn point there.
- Common config can toggle overworld-style structure targeting, passive mob spawns, and hostile mob spawns.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1.x

## Notes

This is a worldgen mod. Existing worlds need newly generated terrain to show new dimension content.

Default config keeps normal overworld first spawn, uses overworld-style structure targeting, enables passive/ambient spawns, and keeps hostile natural spawns disabled.
